ENABLE_LAPTOP_MODE_TOOLS.description: Set to 1 to enable laptop-mode-tools execution, 0 to disable.

VERBOSE_OUTPUT.description: Set to 1 to see verbose information when starting/stopping laptop_mode.

LOG_TO_SYSLOG.description: Set to 1 to log messages to syslog.

DEBUG.description: Set to 1 to run in shell debug mode.

ENABLE_LAPTOP_MODE_ON_BATTERY.description: Enable laptop mode power saving when on battery power.

ENABLE_LAPTOP_MODE_ON_AC.description: Enable laptop mode power savings even when on AC power.

ENABLE_LAPTOP_MODE_WHEN_LID_CLOSED.description: Enable laptop mode when the lid is closed (ACPI-ONLY).

ENABLE_AUTO_MODULES.description: Set to 1 to enable all simple zero-configuration auto modules.

MINIMUM_BATTERY_CHARGE_PERCENT.description: Disable data loss sensitive features when battery reaches this percent.

DISABLE_LAPTOP_MODE_ON_CRITICAL_BATTERY_.description: Disable data loss sensitive features when battery reports critical state.

DISABLE_BATTERY_ALARM_CHECK.description: Ignore the alarm value reported by batteries.

HD.description: Drives that laptop mode controls. Space separated.

PARTITIONS.description: Partitions or mount points that laptop mode controls. Space separated.

ASSUME_SCSI_IS_SATA.description: Assume SCSI drives are SATA and use hdparm.

LM_BATT_MAX_LOST_WORK_SECONDS.description: Max time in seconds of work lost when system crashes on battery.

LM_AC_MAX_LOST_WORK_SECONDS.description: Max time in seconds of work lost when system crashes on AC.

CONTROL_READAHEAD.description: Should laptop mode tools control readahead?

LM_READAHEAD.description: Read-ahead in kilobytes when laptop mode is active.

NOLM_READAHEAD.description: Read-ahead in kilobytes when laptop mode is NOT active.

CONTROL_NOATIME.description: Should laptop mode tools add noatime option to mount options?

USE_RELATIME.description: Should laptop use relatime instead of noatime?

CONTROL_HD_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Should laptop mode tools control hard drive idle timeout settings?

LM_AC_HD_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Idle timeout seconds for AC with laptop mode on.

NOLM_HD_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Idle timeout seconds for AC without laptop mode (NOLM).

CONTROL_HD_POWERMGMT.description: Should laptop mode tools control hard drive power management settings? Set to 0 to disable.

BATT_HD_POWERMGMT.description: Power management value for HD on battery (hdparm -B).

LM_AC_HD_POWERMGMT.description: Power management value for HD on AC with laptop mode (hdparm -B).

NOLM_AC_HD_POWERMGMT.description: Power management value for HD on AC without laptop mode (hdparm -B).

CONTROL_HD_WRITECACHE.description: Should laptop mode tools control hard drive write cache settings?

NOLM_AC_HD_WRITECACHE.description: Write cache setting for HD on AC without laptop mode (hdparm -W).

NOLM_BATT_HD_WRITECACHE.description: Write cache setting for HD on battery (hdparm -W).

LM_HD_WRITECACHE.description: Write cache setting for HD with laptop mode (hdparm -W).

CONTROL_MOUNT_OPTIONS.description: Change mount options on partitions? Don't disable if you want drives to spin down.

LM_DIRTY_RATIO.description: Dirty synchronous ratio percentage when laptop mode is active.

NOLM_DIRTY_RATIO.description: Dirty synchronous ratio percentage when laptop mode is NOT active.

LM_DIRTY_BACKGROUND_RATIO.description: Allowed dirty background ratio percentage when laptop mode is active.

NOLM_DIRTY_BACKGROUND_RATIO.description: Allowed dirty background ratio percentage when laptop mode is NOT active.

XFS_HZ.description: Adjust manually to HZ value in running kernel on 2.4. Usually 100 for 2.6.

LM_SECONDS_BEFORE_SYNC.description: Seconds laptop mode waits after disk goes idle before doing a sync.
